table.retrieve:
SELECT 	Item.Name,  
				aliasname=item.customicode, 
				active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
         		/*PurPrice = Case When (isnull(sum(cast(GodownDetail.CurrQty as int)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN Item.PurPrice Else Round(Item.PurPrice/Item.PackUnits,2) End, 
         		SalePrice = Case When (isnull(sum(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN Item.SalePrice Else Round(Item.SalePrice/Item.PackUnits,2) End, 
				QTY = Case When (isnull(sum(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN  (isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) / Item.PackUnits ) Else isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0)  End,
         		LoosePack = Case When (isnull(sum(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN ' ' Else 'L' End,*/
				stock= Case When (isnull(sum(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN  (isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) / Item.PackUnits ) Else isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0)  End,
				ReOrderQty=max(item.ReOrderQty),
				PurPrice=Item.PurPrice/ (CASE item.packunits when 0 then 1 else Item.packunits end),
				SalePrice=Item.SalePrice/(CASE item.packunits when 0 then 1 else Item.packunits end),
         		Item.PackUnits,   
         		QTY =isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty ),0)
						 - ((select isnull(sum(SD.looseqty+SD.bonusqty),0) from saledetail SD where SD.Due IN ('X','D','S') and SD.icode=Item.Icode)
							- (select isnull(sum(DD.DeletedQty),0) from DueDeleteDetail DD where DD.icode=Item.ICode)
						- (select isnull(sum(DS.DueSatisfyQty),0) from duesatisfydetail DS where DS.icode=item.icode))
 ,
         		Manufacturer.name,
				classname=itemclass.name,
				category=(case :ar_catcode when 0 then 'ALL' else (select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=:ar_catcode) end),
				godownname=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=:ar_gcode),
				PendingDueQty = (select isnull(sum(SD.looseqty+SD.bonusqty),0) from saledetail SD where SD.Due IN ('X','D','S') and SD.icode=Item.Icode)
				- (select isnull(sum(DD.DeletedQty),0) from DueDeleteDetail DD where DD.icode=Item.ICode)
				- (select isnull(sum(DS.DueSatisfyQty),0) from duesatisfydetail DS where DS.icode=item.icode)

FROM 	
			Manufacturer,   
			Item
			LEFT OUTER JOIN GodownDetail ON (Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode),
			itemclass

WHERE 
         	(godowndetail.gcode IN ( case :ar_isallgodown when 'Y' then godowndetail.gcode else :ar_gcode end))and	
			( Item.ICCode IN (:classcode ) ) and
			( itemclass.iccode = Item.iccode ) and
			(item.icatcode IN (case :ar_catcode when 0 then item.icatcode else :ar_catcode end) )AND
			
			( Item.active=1) and
			( Item.manfcode=manufacturer.manfcode)
			
GROUP BY item.icode,Item.name,item.customicode, Item.Active, Item.purprice, Item.SalePrice, Item.PackUnits,Itemclass.name,
				
			 	Itemclass.name ,
			 	Manufacturer.name
